assumptions: 'Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal' is not observable by the camera and is excluded from the check.
'shall stop' interpreted as DWELL stopped still with max_speed 0.05 continuously for at least 1000 ms inside stop_zone; duration is not stated in statute.
stop_zone (last 10 m before stop_line) taken as 'the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line'.
Only inbound crossings from y<0.6 to y>0.6 (to_right per line definition) trigger the requirement, taken as 'approaching'.
Stop must precede the first inbound crossing; vehicles that never cross pass vacuously.
Anchor 'center' used because boxes are top-down with centre as metric position and bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not wheels.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first stopped still in the stop zone before crossing.

provenance.quote: at a clearly marked stop line
stop at the near side of the intersection

provenance.reason: Statute says 'shall stop' with no duration; 1000 ms continuous stopped dwell assumed as minimal observable stop.
Statute only says 'approaching' without cardinal direction; mapped to inbound crossing to_right per line definition moving downwards (+y) = to_right from y<0.6 to y>0.6.
Boxes are top-down with centre as metric position; bottom_center is downstream AABB edge not wheels, so centre matches stop_zone/stop_line geometry.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
